instrument: Virginia SCC Final Order, Case No. PUR-2025-00058 (Rate Schedule GS-5)
summary: GS-5 minimum demand charges are 85% of contracted demand for distribution, 85% for transmission, and 60% for generation. PJM capacity expense is excluded from the generation minimum. Customers served before January 1, 2016 are exempt from minimum demand charges; certain competitive-supply and Schedule 10 customers as of January 1, 2025 are exempt from the generation minimum.
text: The Commission approves Dominion's proposed minimum demand charges: (1) minimum distribution charge of 85% contracted demand; (2) minimum transmission charge of 85% contracted demand; and (3) minimum generation charge of 60% contracted demand. The Commission also approves the Company's proposal to exclude PJM capacity expense from the minimum generation demand charge.

source.citation: Virginia State Corporation Commission, Final Order, Case No. PUR-2025-00058, Application of Virginia Electric and Power Company for a 2025 biennial review, entered November 25, 2025 (Doc. Con. Cen. No. 251140150)

notes: Legacy exemptions (p. 26): (a) minimum demand charges do not apply to a customer taking service before January 1, 2016; (b) minimum generation demand charges do not apply to a customer that as of January 1, 2025 took supply from a competitive service provider, was a Schedule 10-Interruptible customer, or had formally notified Dominion before that date of an intent to elect either before January 1, 2026. Otherwise the generation minimum applies to competitive-supply customers. Footnote 101: planned-maintenance exemptions to be included in Terms and Conditions; rolling 12-month averaging denied. Upgraded from ASSERTED/NOT_CHECKED (2026-09-20).
